name: focus-cards
blurb: Image grid that blurs/scales non-hovered cards while enlarging hovered card.
description: A responsive image card grid that tracks hover state, blurring and scaling sibling cards while the hovered card stays in focus. Gradient title overlay appears on hover.
use_when: Portfolio galleries, product grids, or image-based feature showcases where focus isolation directs attention to one item.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where persistent focus state or multi-card blur could create accessibility confusion.
a11y: Cards are image containers with alt text. Hover focus is visual only; keyboard focus depends on card structure. Blur effects are non-semantic visual feedback.
